judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, bug-free implementation that meets every acceptance criterion in the issue. Both the candidate and reference rename the hook parameter to `totalUsage` and accumulate usage across rounds, though the candidate also introduces a `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts` (explicitly mentioned in the ticket's key files and fourth acceptance criterion). The candidate places the helper `sumUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` with dedicated unit tests and adds a separate acceptance test file rather than appending directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference did. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate puts the new behaviour under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading rather than moving it up to the main requirements list and updating `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md`.
